metadata.title: दुमका में बड़ी बहू का विद्रोह | Sita Soren Interview | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In a strategic move to weaken the JMM's influence in their stronghold, the BJP has enlisted Shibu Soren’s elder daughter-in-law. She reportedly left the JMM due to conflicts with Kalpana Soren and openly expressed her grievances in a candid interview with Main Bhi Bharat. Watch this revealing interview to hear her side of the story and understand the underlying tensions within the Soren family.
